rationale: Least-cost commitment satisfying demand (260 MW), reserve (>=40 MW), and N-1 security. g1+g3=300 MW meets demand+reserve but loses 180 MW (largest unit) leaving only 120 MW, failing N-1. Adding g2 gives 460 MW total; after loss of largest committed unit g3 (180 MW), 280 MW remains >= 260 MW demand. Cost = (400+80)+(550+100)+(700+120)=1950 USD.
